activity.overview: Listen to a short text about storms. Tell how to stay safe.
activity.passage: Sometimes a big storm comes. You may see lightning flash and hear thunder boom. When you hear thunder, go inside a building right away. Stay inside until the storm is over. A weather forecaster studies the sky and tells us what weather is coming. When a storm is on the way, grown-ups listen to the forecast and help us get ready.

questions.prompt: What should you do when you hear thunder?
How long should you stay inside?
What does a weather forecaster do?
Draw a safe place to be in a storm.
